#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Convert docs/customer_report.docx to PDF and email it to bob@example.com.

Requirements:
    pip install docx2pdf

Usage:
    # Set environment variables for your SMTP server before running:
    export SMTP_HOST="smtp.example.com"
    export SMTP_PORT="587"
    export SMTP_USER="you@example.com"
    export SMTP_PASSWORD="your-password"
    export SENDER_EMAIL="you@example.com"

    python convert_and_email.py
"""

import os
import sys
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage
from pathlib import Path

from docx2pdf import convert


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Configuration – edit these or set via environment variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
DOCX_PATH = Path("docs/customer_report.docx")
PDF_PATH = DOCX_PATH.with_suffix(".pdf")          # docs/customer_report.pdf

RECIPIENT = "bob@example.com"
SENDER = os.environ.get("SENDER_EMAIL", "you@example.com")
SUBJECT = "Customer Report (PDF)"
BODY = (
    "Hi Bob,\n\n"
    "Please find the customer report attached as a PDF.\n\n"
    "Best regards"
)

SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "smtp.example.com")
SMTP_PORT = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
SMTP_USER = os.environ.get("SMTP_USER", SENDER)
SMTP_PASSWORD = os.environ.get("SMTP_PASSWORD", "")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 1 – Convert DOCX → PDF
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def convert_docx_to_pdf(docx_path: Path, pdf_path: Path) -> None:
    if not docx_path.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Error: {docx_path} not found.")
    print(f"Converting {docx_path} → {pdf_path} ...")
    convert(str(docx_path), str(pdf_path))
    print(f"PDF created: {pdf_path}  ({pdf_path.stat().st_size:,} bytes)")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 2 – Email the PDF
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def send_email(pdf_path: Path) -> None:
    if not pdf_path.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Error: {pdf_path} not found. Conversion may have failed.")

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = RECIPIENT
    msg["Subject"] = SUBJECT
    msg.set_content(BODY)

    # Attach the PDF
    pdf_data = pdf_path.read_bytes()
    msg.add_attachment(
        pdf_data,
        maintype="application",
        subtype="pdf",
        filename=pdf_path.name,
    )

    print(f"Sending email to {RECIPIENT} via {SMTP_HOST}:{SMTP_PORT} ...")
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as smtp:
        smtp.ehlo()
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.ehlo()
        smtp.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD)
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    print("Email sent successfully!")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    convert_docx_to_pdf(DOCX_PATH, PDF_PATH)
    send_email(PDF_PATH)
